verificationPolicy: A value beyond verifyBelow/verifyAbove requires explicit user confirmation before saving. Unverified values are excluded from every rule.

readiness.disclaimer: Rules-based interpretation of recorded inputs. Not a medical assessment.

evaluationOrder.when: available_independent_inputs >= 3 AND no flag from R1-R2

hrv.baselineMethod: median of verified hrv_ms in the previous 14 days excluding today
hrv.whenBaselineMissing: Personal baseline not established yet (needs 7 measurements in 14 days)

restingHr.whenBaselineMissing: Show the measurement only. No interpretation.

trainingLoad.label: internal proxy estimate
trainingLoad.formula: weekly working sets per muscle (primary x1.0, secondary x0.5)
trainingLoad.whenMissing: Hide chart and ratio. Show: Needs 4 weeks of logged workouts

nutrition.whenMissing: Add your body weight to see a target

rules.when: latest check-in soreness >= 1 for the muscle
last mapped session < 48h ago; wording: Trained recently
only if catalog defaultRecoveryHours is not null (currently never)
